messages:
hana: Heads-up: we need a concise benchmark narrative for next week's webinar. Focus: latency vs cost decision map for engineering and product.

omar: Goal: one hero that non-technical buyers parse in <5s, plus an appendix with methodology.

paul: Idea: use a decision map visual — quadrant chart where X=latency, Y=cost, and pins show typical apps (chat, search, embedding). Add a small legend for deploy modes (hosted/dedicated/private).

ivy: Love a quadrant for quick decisions. Can we pair it with a tiny table that gives $/1k tokens for each deploy mode for a sample workload? Makes the tradeoff actionable.

metrics-bot: export ready -> /eng-ml/benchmarks/214567/export.csv (medians across 10 runs, default batch=8).

hana: Messaging: headline test A = "Choose your tradeoff: latency or cost" vs B = "Where should you run inference?" We'll A/B on the landing hero.

omar: Routing: clicks on hero -> 3-field form (company size, infra interest, tokens/day). >500M/day -> SDR. infra=private -> AE. Others -> nurture.

paul: Design notes: use colorblind palette, shapes for deploy modes, tooltips with P50/P95 and cost delta vs hosted. Keep model names generic on hero.

ivy: Social hooks: "Same model, different economics. See where you should run it." and "Latency vs cost: which matters for your app?" Test both.

hana: Action items: paul -> quadrant spec + sample numbers; omar -> landing copy + form; ivy -> social hooks + A/B plan. I'll assemble methodology slide and one-pager. Deadline EOD tomorrow.

omar: I'll draft the form and landing copy today.

metrics-bot: reminder: methodology doc available at /eng-ml/benchmarks/214567/method.md

hana: Thanks everyone. If you have competitor visuals that nail the decision map, drop them here.
